*.NamedBindMarkerExpression: A text-consumer node: only the inline text rendering (IPolicyPredicateRenderer) emits it; the bound compile path rejects it in every dialect (NotSupportedException).

Oracle.IntervalLiteralExpression: An interval value has no bound form on Oracle (NUMTODSINTERVAL has no MONTH or YEAR field); the generator rejects the construct (SqlCompileNotSupportedException).
Oracle.MergeDeleteClause: The compile pipeline rejects the MERGE ... THEN DELETE fixtures for Oracle (SqlCompileNotSupportedException).

SqlServer.ArrayConstructorExpression: T-SQL has no array type; the generator rejects the construct (SqlCompileNotSupportedException).
SqlServer.SubscriptExpression: T-SQL has no array subscripts; the generator rejects the construct (SqlCompileNotSupportedException).
SqlServer.IntervalLiteralExpression: SQL Server has no interval type; the builder rejects the construct.
SqlServer.UsingJoinCondition: T-SQL has no JOIN ... USING; the builder rejects the construct.

Databricks.ArrayConstructorExpression: Array constructors and subscripts are not supported for Databricks; the builder rejects the construct.
Databricks.SubscriptExpression: Array constructors and subscripts are not supported for Databricks; the builder rejects the construct.

Sqlite.DateFunctionExpression: date_add and date_trunc need inline string literals (datetime modifiers, strftime formats) on SQLite; the generator rejects them (SqlCompileNotSupportedException).
Sqlite.ExtractExpression: EXTRACT needs a strftime format literal on SQLite; the generator rejects it (SqlCompileNotSupportedException).
Sqlite.TypedLiteralExpression: DATE/TIME/TIMESTAMP literals would be inline string literals on SQLite; the generator rejects them (SqlCompileNotSupportedException).
Sqlite.GroupingOperationExpression: GROUPING() is not supported for SQLite (no grouping sets); the builder rejects the construct.
Sqlite.IntervalLiteralExpression: SQLite has no interval type; the builder rejects the construct.
Sqlite.MergeStatement: MERGE is not supported on SQLite (statement class); the compile pipeline rejects it.
Sqlite.MergeUpdateClause: MERGE is not supported on SQLite (statement class); the compile pipeline rejects it.
Sqlite.MergeDeleteClause: MERGE is not supported on SQLite (statement class); the compile pipeline rejects it.
Sqlite.MergeInsertClause: MERGE is not supported on SQLite (statement class); the compile pipeline rejects it.
